normaliser: three-way.mjs normalise (furniture by source, then NFC, long s to s, line-end hyphens joined, whitespace collapsed, re-wrapped to 72 columns); normalizeForScript v4 for cer_conv
align_rule: set A/B: best F1 of typed-reference words over every Archive leaf >= 0.5; set C: the image's own leaf (moved only for a clear drift)

adjudicators: opus + sonnet via claude -p, ADJ3_PROMPT, all arms of a page in one call, unlabelled; confirmed = both say the page prints something else
